## Invitations

The North City outreach activity invited 6840 people. Of those invited, 5291 attended, representing an attendance rate of 77.4 per cent. This provides a clear view of participation during the reporting period and supports continued monitoring of engagement with invitations. Attendance figures are recorded alongside the invitation total to support consistent reporting and review.

The invitation process included direct SMS contact for 5747 people. Reminder messages were also sent to 5747 people, providing an additional prompt ahead of attendance. These communication measures formed part of the outreach approach and were used to support participation.

## Contact

Staff continue to phone people who missed appointments, ensuring that contact remains available where attendance has not taken place. Telephone follow-up complements the SMS and reminder activity and supports ongoing engagement with the service.

Prepared by G. Evans.
